name: Thread-fence single-pass reduction
description: A single-kernel-launch sum reduction using __threadfence() + a global atomic ticket counter (the last block to finish combines all partial sums itself) contrasted with the classic two-kernel-launch tree reduction.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: reduceBlock/reduceBlocks/reduceMultiPass/reduceSinglePass/retirementCount/setRetirementCount reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples threadFenceReduction_kernel.cuh. Host driver, gen_input, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-15.
notes: Real-extraction thread-fence reduction case from collection snapshot sk-15. N=131072, input[i]=((i%29)-14)*0.25, exact total = -21.0 (both outputs). Every float32 add is exact -> exact oracle.
